summary: Instruction–data separation composes with context selection, explicit tool contracts and host-enforced authority boundaries.

items.text: Prompt Enrichment Preprocessing chooses context; the boundary preserves each selected block's origin and prevents retrieved context from becoming policy.
Carry provenance and trust class through every tool result so computer observations remain data rather than new instructions.
Use Sandbox to contain consequences when hostile content still influences an action proposal.
Use Agent Fencing so no content block can expand the task's platform-owned authority grant.
